learnings.title: Emotion words
learnings.focus: Name and read words for feelings.
lookFor: Names a feeling like happy or sad
Knows a way to calm down (take a breath, talk about a worry)

playgrounds.note: Trace and say words for how we feel
Spell out words for how we feel
Listen and name how someone feels

learnings.title: Looking after myself
learnings.focus: Help a friend notice they need the toilet and follow every step, from bathroom to washing hands.
lookFor: Notices the friend needs the toilet
Follows the steps — bathroom, potty, wash hands
Chooses the toilet over the nappy or toys
Talks about their own toilet routine

playgrounds.note: Help your friend recognise the need and follow every step to the potty
